title: The posting program's input
description: posting/v1 — one JSON object on the program's input, then its end: where to send, a secret, and the meeting's name; for notion, the integration's key too; for a confidential meeting, its confirmation; the parts of the summary a person chose, and the dates with their heading. What a schema cannot say is on the contract's page: which addresses are refused.

key.description: notion alone: the integration's key, a secret.

confirmed_confidential.description: true once the person confirmed sending a confidential meeting, for this send alone; false when absent.

parts.description: The parts of the summary sent, the title always sent and never one of them; absent, the summary is sent whole, as before. Each part once.

dates.description: exporting/v1's dates, as the shell gives them: sent only when `parts` names `dates`, each as « date — what — who », never its `passage`. What a schema cannot say is on the contract's page.

dates_title.description: The dates' heading, in the person's language: required by the program when `parts` names `dates` and `dates` is given.
